description:
Returns a collection of Response Logs scoped to viewable Observations

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYY...

id.description: Unique identifier for this Response Log entry. Pass as the `{id}` path parameter to `GET /rest/v1.0/observations/items/{item_id}/response_logs/{id}`.

item_id.description: ID of the Observation Item this Response Log belongs to. Use as the `{item_id}` path parameter when reading sibling Response Logs.

status.description: Status the Observation was moved to by this Response Log, stored in title-cased form. Comment-only entries carry the Observation's status at the time the comment was posted. Note the casing differs...

comment.description: Free-text note recorded with this Response Log. Null when the entry was generated by a status change with no accompanying comment.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the Response Log was recorded. Response Logs are returned oldest-first, so this doubles as the activity-feed ordering key.

updated_at.description: Deprecated — not returned by this endpoint. Response Logs are immutable once created; use `created_at`.

created_by_name.description: Deprecated — not returned by this endpoint. Use `created_by.name`.

attachments.description: Files attached to this Response Log. Each entry is either a Procore-stored file or a Procore Document Management document reference. Add attachments on create with `response_log[upload_ids]` or `re...

created_by.description: User who recorded this Response Log.

name.description: Author's name as captured when the Response Log was created. Stored on the record, so it does not change if the user is later renamed.
